prompt: Inventory YouTube channel videos, generate and update video metadata in bulk, verify updates, and fetch captions/transcript for a YouTube video.

results.use_case: Inventory YouTube channel videos, generate and update video metadata in bulk, verify updates, and fetch captions/transcript for a YouTube video.
results.execution_guidance: Found 4 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: YouTube is a video-sharing platform with user-generated content, live streaming, and monetization opportunities, widely used for marketing, education, and entertainment
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=youtube. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="youtube") to create a connection BEFORE executing any youtube tools.

YOUTUBE_LIST_CAPTION_TRACK.description: Retrieves a list of caption tracks for a YouTube video. Returns an empty items list if no captions are available. Raises ExecutionFailed if the video ID is invalid or not found.

part.description: Specifies a comma-separated list of one or more caption resource parts that the API response will include. Valid parts are 'id' and 'snippet'.

video_id.description: The YouTube video ID for which the API should return caption tracks.

YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CAPTION.description: Updates a YouTube caption track's metadata such as name, language, or draft status. Use this to modify existing caption track properties without uploading new caption content. Note: Only properties specified in the snippet will be updated; unspecified properties retain their current values.

id.description: The unique caption track ID assigned by YouTube. This is NOT the video ID. To obtain this ID, call YOUTUBE_LIST_CAPTION_TRACK with a video_id to get the list of available caption tracks and their IDs.

name.description: Display name for the caption track (max 150 characters).

isDraft.description: Draft status of the caption track. If true, the track is not publicly visible.

videoId.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the video associated with the caption track.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag identifying the caption language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

snippet.description: Snippet object containing the caption properties to update. Only specified fields will be updated.

YOUTUBE_LOAD_CAPTIONS.description: Downloads a specific YouTube caption track, which must be owned by the authenticated user, and returns its content as text. Note: This action requires you to own the video (YouTube Data API v3 restriction). Non-owned videos will return 403 Forbidden errors, including many auto-generated caption tracks.

id.description: The unique caption track ID assigned by YouTube. This is NOT the video ID. To obtain this ID, first call YOUTUBE_LIST_CAPTION_TRACK with a video_id to get the list of available caption tracks and their IDs.

tfmt.description: Desired format for the caption track. Supported formats: 'srt' (SubRip), 'sbv' (SubViewer), 'vtt' (WebVTT).

YOUTUBE_LIST_CHANNEL_VIDEOS.description: Lists videos from a specified YouTube channel. This action primarily uses the playlistItems.list end...
